rule: Stratify by (domain, language); within a stratum order by task_id and assign alternately from a stratum-specific offset derived from the seed. Target ~60% dev. Deterministic: re-running reproduces it exactly.
note: HOLDOUT IS NOT TO BE MEASURED during development, including by the pilot. It exists so the final H1 evaluation has data the harness was never tuned against. Spending it early cannot be undone.
